about: The flags' lines. 'live' = the vinci wing's calm caps (src/wings/vinci/calm-check.mjs, CALM and CALM_STANDING.desktop, at its T1 = 2) or forge/film/motion.mjs MOTION_CAPS; 'guess' = set here, to tune against what judges see.

walking.source: live: CALM 12, 12 and 40 times T1, T1^2, T1^3; filmPixelsPerFrame 18 at 1920 px and 30 fps

standing.source: live: CALM_STANDING.desktop 36, 23 and 60 times T1, T1^2, T1^3; filmPixelsPerFrame 28 at 1920 px and 30 fps

bodyMetresPerSecond3.source: guess: the live 2 m/s2 reached in no less than half a second

zoomPerSecond.source: live: CALM.zoomPerSecond (the lens's change as a share of the picture's scale per second)

standingMetresPerSecond.source: live: motion.mjs middleOf's moved test (0.05 m/s)

stillDegPerSecond.source: guess: a view turning under 1 deg/s reads as held

minStopSeconds.source: guess: a still run shorter than this is a turning point, not a stop

minHoldSeconds.source: guess: an editing rule of thumb that a held frame needs about two seconds to be read

settleMetresPerSecond.source: guess: arriving at a hold faster than this over its last quarter second reads as a stop, not a settle

settleDegPerSecond.source: guess: as settleMetresPerSecond, for the view's turn

driftShare.source: guess: an authored hold that moves over this share of its frames drifts

farM.source: guess: the far point sits 20 m out along the frame's centre and side rays

derivativeHalfSeconds.source: guess: each derivative is a central difference over +-0.1 s, so jerk reads over about 0.6 s of track

motionCaps.source: live: forge/film/motion.mjs MOTION_CAPS through motionVerdict, per move (the weave flag)
